items.description: Major maritime gateway for West Africa, facilitating trade and transit to neighboring countries. It serves as a vital logistics hub for the Senegalese economy.
Important river port on the Saloum River, primarily used for the transport of agricultural products like groundnuts. It plays a significant role in regional trade within central Senegal.
One of the largest photovoltaic power plants in West Africa, contributing substantially to the national grid. It promotes renewable energy development in the Saint-Louis region.
Built in 1864, this historic lighthouse stands on the Mamelles hills and has guided ships towards Dakar for over a century. It remains a functional navigation aid and a prominent landmark.
A historic metal truss bridge connecting Saint-Louis island to the mainland, designed by the Eiffel company. It is a symbol of the city's colonial heritage and engineering history.
A modern multi-purpose stadium located in Diamniadio, hosting major international sporting events. It is a premier venue for football and national celebrations.
A well-known multi-purpose stadium in Dakar named after the country's first president. It has been a central venue for Senegalese sports and large public gatherings for decades.
The country's main performing arts venue, dedicated to promoting Senegalese culture and theater. It hosts prestigious music, dance, and drama performances.
A world-class museum in Dakar showcasing the history, art, and contributions of African civilizations. It features diverse exhibitions highlighting regional heritage.
A contemporary cultural landmark in Dakar, designed for large-scale concerts, theater plays, and national conferences. It reflects the city's vibrant modern art scene.
The official residence and workplace of the President of Senegal, featuring stunning colonial architecture. It is an iconic building located in the Plateau district.
The headquarters of the Central Bank of West African States, an imposing skyscraper in Dakar. It is a significant financial center and a landmark of the city's business district.
A unique mosque known for its distinctive architecture and location overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. It is a center of spiritual significance in Dakar.
